ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity dark/black pixels distributed across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity dark region originates at the peduncle attachment and extends outward towards the mid-lobe area. Fine-scale dark linear streaks and isolated dark spots are distributed across the primary white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees and significant depth relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency serrations and several larger, non-uniform notches, particularly prominent on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer edges tapering to sharp points at the lateral tips; the trailing edge follows a generally concave trajectory towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the distal white regions of the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying orientations and lengths across both lobes, with a highly concentrated set of parallel lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jaggedness along the entire trailing edge; large, high-contrast dark curved scars are visible on the medial portions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique set of five parallel vertical dark lines located on the upper-mid section of the right lobe and a prominent 'C' shaped dark mark on the medial right lobe.
